data.summary: On 25 Sep 2026, two archived programs targeted AIHW's "Mental health in aged care" Tableau dashboard. The archived output shows the data request was refused (HTTP 403, PermissionDeniedException). This is a return toa topic targeted in June (#132, #140)
data.description:
Target. The Australian Institute of Health and Welfare's public Tableau server, vizprod.aihw.gov.au. Workbook: AGE115_MentalhealthinAgedCare_19072024. View: "F05 Age-specific crude rates", filtered to Cohort "Permanent residential aged care" and Condition "Mood disorders". This is not the PBS medicines workbook covered by #77, #104, #115, #129 and #132.

The two programs. Both are httpbin.org/base64 pages saved to the Wayback Machine. Each loads AIHW's Tableau JavaScript library and embeds the view.

Program A (captured 09:02:04 UTC) asks for the "F05 Number graph" worksheet's summary data, up to 100 rows. It sends the result, or any error, to ntfy.sh/mha3x in 1,200-character pieces.
Program B (captured 09:02:29 UTC) selects the "65–69" age group on the chart, reads the selected values, and sends them to a different ntfy server, ntfy.envs.net/m1955120.
Outcome. A Wayback capture of ntfy.sh/mha3x at 09:02:10 UTC, six seconds after Program A's capture, holds the program's own report: 0/ERR api-get-worksheet-summary-logical-table-data: {"code":0,"message":"PermissionDeniedException"}, status: 403. AIHW's server refused the summary-data request. Program B's channel has not been checked yet, because the Wayback Machine was offline during review.

Timing. The program was captured, and six seconds later its output message was captured. This matches the post-and-archive coupling #148 found for July ntfy runs, and extends that recovery method to September.

Earlier activity on the same topic.
#132 records a CORS read test of aihw.gov.au/reports/aged-care/mental-health-in-aged-care on 18 June.
#140 notes that Asymmetric Security's report describes an ntfy upload named boot.gz, about 35 KB, from an AIHW mental-health-in-aged-care dashboard. That file was not recovered.
So this dashboard was a target before. On 25 September, the request was refused.

Interpretation. Summary data in Tableau can be switched off for a public view. The 403 may mean it was never enabled for this workbook, or that access changed after June. These records cannot tell which. The programs used Tableau's documented embedding interface, and no evidence of getting past an access control was found.

Limits:

Program B's outcome is unknown until the ntfy.envs.net channel is checked.
Whether the June boot.gz upload came from the same workbook and view is not established.
No requester identity, model or provider appears in the records.
Program A's carrier URL ends in ?uq=mha3x1324. The meaning of "uq" is not interpreted here.
Method: Read-only analysis of Wayback CDX records for httpbin.org/base64 (21–30 Sep 2026) and ntfy.sh/mha3x. The programs were decoded as text and not run.
